```{r}
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
library(tigris)

census_api_key("8f115ef276960ce1d8fe7d1a449dd616c8ecf785", install = TRUE, overwrite=TRUE)
```

```{R}
# Download nationwide ZCTA data
zcta_data <- get_acs(
  geography = "zcta",
  variables = c(
    median_income = "B19013_001", 
    population = "B01003_001",
    median_rent = "B25064_001"
  ),
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)

# Retrieve shapefiles for the five NYC counties
nyc_counties <- counties(state = "NY", cb = TRUE, year = 2020) %>%
  filter(NAME %in% c("New York", "Kings", "Queens", "Bronx", "Richmond"))

# Select ZCTAs belonging to NYC using spatial intersection
nyc_acs_data <- st_join(zcta_data, nyc_counties, join = st_intersects, left = FALSE)

head(nyc_acs_data)

```
